# mtncloud_chef_server (Data Source)

Provides an MTN Cloud Chef server data source: looks up a Chef server integration by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_chef_server" "example_chef_server" {
  name = "Demo Chef Server"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the chef server

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
